name: Classic English
text:
The object of English
Peg Solitaire is to
capture as many pieces
as you can by
"jumping" over them
into empty squares.
Only vertical and
horizontal jumping is
allowed.

For different boards,
choose "Options" from
the "Game" menu.

name: Classic French
text:
The object of classic
French Peg Solitaire is
to capture as many
pieces as possible. Only
vertical and horizontal
jumping is allowed.

Classic French Solitaire
is more dificult than its
English counterpart.

Good Luck!

name: Restaraunt
text:
This game is equivalent
to the triangular boards
seen in some American
restaraunts (usually
played with golf tees).

Horizontal, vertical, and
diagonal jumps are
allowed.

This game is fairly easy
to get down to one peg.

name: The X
text:
The object of The X is to
capture as many pieces
as possible. Only
horizontal and vertical
jumps are allowed.

Good Luck!

name: The Diamond
text:
The object of The
Diamond is to capture
as many pieces as
possible. Only
horizontal and vertical
jumps are allowed.

Good Luck!

name: Checkers
text:
The object of Checkers
is to clear as much of
the board as possible
using only diagonal
jumps.

This board is much
more difficult to clear
than English or French
Solitaire.

name: Checkers II
text:
The object of Checkers
II is to capture as many
pieces as possible. Only
diagonal jumping is
allowed.

Good Luck!

name: The Center
text:
The object of "The
Center" is to completely
clear the board except
for a single piece in the
center.

Only vertical and
horizontal jumps are
allowed.

name: The Wall
text:

Wall" is to clear the
inner part of the board,
leaving a wall of pegs
around the perimeter.

Only vertical and
horizontal jumps are
allowed.
